mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_asset WHERE asset_id IN #{id} ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT * FROM kb_asset WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_asset WHERE create_by=#{createBy} AND external_key=#{externalKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_asset SET status='UPLOADING',failure_message=NULL,upload_token=#{uploadToken},update_time=NOW() WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND (status='FAILED' OR (status='UPLOADING' AND COALESCE(update_time,create_time) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_asset WHERE test_run_id=#{testRunId} ORDER BY asset_id
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_asset SET status=#{status},oss_version_id=#{ossVersionId},failure_message=#{failureMessage},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND status='UPLOADING' AND upload_token=#{uploadToken}
UPDATE kb_asset SET status='DELETE_PENDING',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND status IN ('READY','FAILED','DELETE_PENDING')
